title: Day 5: Clustering, Latent Factors & Recommender Systems
subtitle: K-Means, Hierarchical Linkage, DBSCAN, Market Basket Analysis (Apriori), Collaborative Filtering & Matrix Factorization
duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)
summary: Master unsupervised data discovery and modern recommendation systems. Explore K-Means, Hierarchical agglomerative clustering, and DBSCAN on non-convex shapes with live Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, and Calinski-Harabasz metrics. Compute exact Apriori Support, Confidence, and Lift. Calculate mean-centered User-User and Item-Item collaborative filtering predictions, and trace Matrix Factorization (SVD) and Neural Collaborative Filtering (NCF).
